convention.basis: C^8 = (C^2)^(x)3; |x> = |x_1>(x)|x_2>(x)|x_3> with x = 4 x_1 + 2 x_2 + x_3; tensor factor 1 is the most significant bit (docs/data.md#hoggar-covariance-and-exact-proof)
convention.label_packing: a = 4 a_1 + 2 a_2 + a_3 and b = 4 b_1 + 2 b_2 + b_3 (bit 2 is tensor factor 1)
convention.normalization: psi = v/sqrt(12), v = (-1+2i,1,1,1,1,1,1,1); no anchor gauge (the global phase is as written)
convention.sic_condition: |<psi|P_{a,b} psi>|^2 = 1/9 for all (a,b) != (0,0); the 64 lines P_{a,b} psi are pairwise equiangular

notes: Not Weyl-Heisenberg covariant for Z/8 and not part of the 174-ray Weyl-Heisenberg catalogue; exceptional entry at d = 8.

npz.planned_metadata: archive comment: exceptional member, group 3-qubit Pauli, not Weyl-Heisenberg covariant
